description: This file defines the LocationDao class, which provides data access functionalities for Location entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, searching, counting, saving, and deleting location data, as well as related database queries involving locations, employees, and associated filters.

classes.name: LocationDao
classes.description: Data access object for managing Location entities, providing methods for CRUD operations and location-related searches.

methods.name: getLocationById
methods.description: Retrieve a Location entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getExistingLocationIds
methods.description: Get a list of existing location IDs from a list of input IDs.

methods.name: getSearchLocationListCount
methods.description: Count the number of locations matching search filters.

methods.name: searchLocations
methods.description: Search for locations matching specified filters.

methods.name: searchLocationsPaginator
methods.description: Internal method to prepare a paginated query for locations based on filters.

methods.name: getNumberOfEmployeesForLocation
methods.description: Get the number of employees associated with a specific location.

methods.name: getLocationsIdList
methods.description: Retrieve a list of all location IDs, ordered by name.

methods.name: getLocationIdsForEmployees
methods.description: Get location IDs for a list of employee numbers.

methods.name: getLocationsByIds
methods.description: Retrieve Location entities corresponding to a list of IDs.

methods.name: saveLocation
methods.description: Persist a Location entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteLocations
methods.description: Delete locations with specified IDs from the database.
